course.life.ask.clearBody: Every gate of this course goes. Undo (Ctrl+Z) brings them all back.
course.life.ask.newSaved: The {n} gates on screen leave the editor. Your saved courses stay in Courses.
course.life.ask.newUnsaved: The {n} gates on screen and your changes that are not saved will be lost. Press No and Save first to keep them.
course.life.ask.genSaved: All {n} gates on screen are replaced by a new course. Your saved courses stay in Courses.
course.life.ask.genUnsaved: All {n} gates on screen are replaced by a new course, and your changes that are not saved are lost. Press No and Save first to keep them.
course.life.ask.otherSaved: The {n} gates on screen leave the editor. Your saved courses stay in Courses.
course.life.ask.otherUnsaved: The {n} gates on screen and your changes that are not saved will be lost. Press No and Save first to keep them.
course.life.empty: Empty course. Add gate is on: click where the first gate stands
course.life.saveEmpty: Nothing to save yet: the course has no gate. Add gate is on: click where the first gate stands
course.life.flySwitch: Your controller arms with its switch: flip the arm switch to fly the course
course.life.flyEmpty: The course has no gate yet. Add gate is on: click where the first gate stands, then Fly the course
course.life.backSwitch: Your controller arms with its switch: flip the arm switch off to edit again
